seo.description: Explore Tangier’s medina: Grand Socco entrance, Petit Socco cafés, markets and the climb toward the kasbah.
seo.keywords: Tangier medina, Petit Socco, Grand Socco, Tangier old town

name: Tangier Medina
hero_subtitle: Lanes from the Grand Socco up toward the kasbah.

overview.title: The old town between port and kasbah
overview.p1: Tangier’s medina rises from the port edge toward the kasbah on the hill. Unlike the denser imperial medinas, it feels open in places — Petit Socco as a café hinge, market streets, and stepped lanes that still reward slow wandering.
overview.p2: Start from the Grand Socco gate, drift to Petit Socco, then climb when you want views. Keep valuables close in crowded stretches; evenings are atmospheric but some lanes empty out.

1.title: Quiet alleys
1.desc: Softer light and fewer crowds in the upper lanes.

2.title: Market energy
2.desc: Shops open, Petit Socco busy — good for people-watching.

3.title: Golden walls
3.desc: Warm light on whitewashed streets toward the kasbah.

food.title: Eat in the medina
food.p1: Cafés on Petit Socco and simple kitchens in the lanes — good for a pause between climbs.
food.li3: Mint tea with a view higher up.
food.li5: Busier spots fill at peak hours.
food.p2: For a longer seafood meal, the port area is a short walk downhill.

1.title: Getting there
1.desc: Walk from the Grand Socco or the port edge; petit taxis drop at the main gates.

2.title: Orientation
2.desc: Uphill generally leads toward the kasbah; downhill toward the port and new town.

3.title: Safety
3.desc: Normal city awareness in crowds; agree taxi fares before longer rides.

q1.question: Is the medina safe to walk?
q1.answer: Yes for standard daytime and early evening walking. Stay aware in dense crowds and use known gates at night.

q2.question: How long do I need?
q2.answer: Two to three hours for a first loop including Petit Socco and a kasbah approach.

q3.question: Do I need a guide?
q3.answer: Not required; maps and main axes are manageable. A guide helps with history and shortcuts.

q4.question: Where does the medina start?
q4.answer: The Grand Socco is the main hinge from the new town; smaller gates open from the port side.

q5.question: Best photo light?
q5.answer: Late afternoon on the upper lanes and kasbah edge.
